glosses: durch Saugen aufnehmen, saugend zu sich nehmen

examples.text: „Erie, ich mach dich so total fertig, dass die Fotze deiner Mama dich vor Scham wieder einsaugt.“

glosses: To draw inward using suction. Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see suck, in.

examples.text: This is the component of the vacuum cleaner that sucks in dust.
I sucked in my belly, hoping to hide the extra weight I had put on over the holidays.

glosses: To cause (someone) to become slowly more and more involved in some business or situation that may not be to their advantage.

examples.text: I really didn't want to be on the committee, but somehow I got sucked in.
